FR-001.title: Every catalog list with an entity-lifecycle status facet applies a default on arrival instead of listing every record

FR-003.title: The applied default is shown as the selected value in the filter UI

FR-004.title: The unfiltered set is reachable in one interaction and that choice persists like any user-chosen filter

FR-005.title: An explicit status in a shared link takes precedence over the default

FR-006.title: The filters-applied indicator counts the default-applied status

FR-007.title: POS sales, sales orders and cash sessions keep their current filtering, unchanged — this feature must not alter it

FR-008.title: Submitting search re-requests the current page even when nothing changed

FR-009.title: A changed term produces exactly one request, not two

FR-010.title: Typing issues no request; the shared search control keeps no per-keystroke callback

FR-011.title: A search refresh preserves page index, sort and every active facet

FR-012.title: An in-flight refresh uses the existing loading affordance without blanking the rows

FR-013.title: Filter row content edges align with the list surface content edges at every width

FR-014.title: Filter row internal spacing is symmetric left and right

FR-015.title: All new spacing comes from shared spacing tokens, no literals

FR-016.title: Alignment is asserted by tests measuring real insets

FR-017.title: All four list-surface corners carry the same radius from the shared shape scale

FR-018.title: The column-header band does not paint over the surface top corners

FR-019.title: The list surface carries a one-logical-pixel hairline outline in the variant outline colour

FR-020.title: Shape and outline rules hold for both paginated and non-paginated list surfaces

FR-021.title: Shape and outline are expressed once in the design system; no screen passes its own

FR-022.title: Shape and outline hold in both themes and at every text-scaling level

FR-023.title: Facility card and warehouse/point-of-sale/cash-drawer rows carry the same hairline outline

FR-024.title: Those surfaces take their radii from the shared shape scale

FR-025.title: Hover and selected states stay distinguishable once the outline is present

FR-026.title: The 14 named entities open in the shared responsive panel from both create and row click

FR-027.title: Row click opens read-only; create opens editable

FR-028.title: A read-only panel offers an edit control only to a user holding the update privilege

FR-029.title: Delete is available inside the panel with the existing confirmation, gated on the delete privilege

FR-030.title: Per-record addresses and screens for the 14 entities are removed; an old address lands on the list

FR-031.title: Saving or deleting closes the panel and updates the list without losing page, filters or sort

FR-032.title: Dismissing a panel with unsaved changes warns before discarding them

FR-033.title: The panel is wide enough for the shared multi-column form layout to still produce more than one column

FR-034.title: Facility children open in a panel without leaving the Facilities screen

FR-035.title: Every field a converted form already offers, including Customers' entity-picker autocompletes, keeps working unchanged from the panel

FR-036.title: Entities outside the named list keep their full-screen record presentation

FR-037.title: Governing design rules are amended to speak of a record's surface rather than a route

FR-038.title: Styling rules are enforced so a new list screen inherits them with no styling code of its own

context: area: lib/core/widgets (catalog_filter_bar, data_table_view, catalog_search_bar, app_side_sheet, responsive_form_grid, record_form_actions)
area: lib/core/design (component_themes, shapes, spacing) — the single enforcement point for FR-013..FR-024
area: lib/features/catalog/presentation (14 *_detail_screen.dart + *_list_screen.dart), lib/features/pricing, lib/features/sales list screens
constraint: constitution v1.12.0 §VI — row click opens a read-only detail SCREEN and delete lives on that screen; FR-026..FR-030 require amending this to speak of a record surface
constraint: constitution §VI already permits a form in a dialog/sheet launched from the filter row, so only the row-click/delete/edit-toggle clauses actually conflict
constraint: showAppSideSheet is a fixed 360dp panel and ResponsiveFormGrid derives columns from inner width — converted forms collapse to one column unless the panel widens (FR-033)
constraint: root cause of the square top corners is dataTableTheme.headingRowColor painting over an unclipped Card, not a missing radius
intent: Close seven cross-cutting CRUD UI gaps — default-Active filtering, filter-row alignment, always-refetching search, fully rounded hairline-outlined tables and facility cards, and side-panel record forms for 14 simple entities — enforcing every durable styling rule in the design system so future screens inherit it.
expectations: Products, Facilities, Taxpayer Issuers, Users and User Profiles keep their full-screen record presentation — not converted to panels
No per-record deep link is preserved for the 14 converted entities; old addresses resolve to the list
No change to what the server stores or exposes, beyond the default status filter and the search refresh
No per-keystroke search; submission stays the only query trigger
No compact/phone-tier redesign of data tables (card-list transformation remains out of scope)
Default status filtering on POS sales, sales orders and cash sessions — deferred: the server accepts only a single scalar status, so the intended multi-state defaults are unimplementable
No mbe-api change is requested and no external dependency is carried; the transactional lists are left as-is by decision
